p: Molech: By Molech he means any type of idol, Le 18:21
set my face against that man: Read Le 17:10,18:21.
people of the land do any: Though the people be negligent to do their duty, and defend God's right, yet he will not allow wickedness to go unpunished.
whoring after them: To esteem sorcerers or conjurers is spiritual whoredom, or idolatry.
his blood shall be upon him: He is worthy to die.
it is wickedness: It is an abominable and detestable thing.
childless: They shall be cut off from their people, and their children shall be taken as bastards, and not counted among the Israelites.
floweth with milk and honey: Full of abundance of all things.
abominable by beast: By eating them contrary to my commandment.
